brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE original Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, a wide landscape PNG, 2048 x 1152 pixels, 16:9.
Style reference: the approved black/lime thumbnail already viewed in this conversation (B-culver-black-lime-v3.png). Borrow its charcoal #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm white, coarse hand-drawn ink hatching, energetic dry-brush streaks, huge readable Japanese typography, strong editorial hierarchy, and restrained orange basketball accent. DO NOT copy the reference player's face, name, scores, date, pose, or wording.
Subject identity reference: the official portrait of real basketball player Yusei Sano / 佐野悠星 (Tryhoop Okayama), viewed in this conversation, local reference references/sano-yusei-official.webp, official https://tryhoop.com/files/rcms_conv_webp/files/user/sano_yusei_hp_main.png_1792456522.webp?v=1792456536 . Use it ONLY to guide likeness, never paste any photograph. Draw only this one real player. His recognizable features: short black hair with parted raised front exposing the forehead, short sides, slim oval face with a slightly angular jaw, straight dark brows, focused dark eyes, straight nose, clean shaven, young adult Japanese man, compact lean athletic guard physique. Keep likeness specific, do not invent a generic player or make him resemble the athlete in the style reference.
Composition: left 54% is clear typographic space, right 46% a dynamic three-quarter-view illustration of Sano leaning forward into a low dribble, torso and thighs visible. He faces diagonally toward the viewer and left, with face clearly visible rather than profile. One anatomically natural hand is controlling the orange basketball near hip height; other arm balances the action. Keep head, both hands and ball fully inside the canvas; anatomically coherent arms and natural five-fingered hands. The lower legs can end in intentional brush marks. He wears an unbranded warm-white and charcoal sleeveless basketball uniform with tiny lime trim; no names, numbers, insignia, sponsors or logos. Draw all of him in visible ink-and-brush illustration, with black/white/grey face shading and controlled lime edge accents, never photographic. A diagonal sweeping lime brush behind him supplies movement. No additional people.
Content basis: frozen article for 2026-11-21 shows B.ONE and B.NEXT games all before start, and says that day's EFF TOP3 and retrospectively selected best five remain pending until all official records are final. There are NO named players in the article; Sano was randomly selected from a mentioned team's current official roster for visual illustration only. This drawing is NOT a reconstruction of an actual play and must not imply his participation, performance, ranking, result or selection among the best five. No fabricated score or result. All article-derived visible information is specified verbatim below.
Typography / Text (verbatim, no extra words):
Top-left small: "バスケまとめ"
Main left upper, extremely large electric lime: "11/21"
Main left middle, huge bold warm white Japanese: "試合予定"
Under headline, medium warm white: "B.ONE・B.NEXT"
Small lime badge near this block: "試合前"
Along the lower band, readable bold warm white: "当日TOP3・ベスト5は公式記録確定待ち"
Below that, smaller but clearly readable: "2026/11/21 02:42〜02:43 JST時点"
At the very bottom left, clear warm-white disclosure: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Beside this disclosure: "イメージ"
Keep the long lower information line within a protected full-width dark footer band, do not cover it with the player or ball. Minimum safe margin 5% on all edges for text, head and hands. All Japanese characters must be correct, sharp, and readable. Plenty of separation. Do not include player name or jersey number anywhere. Do not include club logos, league logos, sponsor text, official photos, badges resembling logos, watermarks, scoreboards, stat claims, victory imagery, or a visible actual-game setting. Final image must be a clearly stylized editorial illustration, like an ink sports poster, with few elements and strong legibility.

SINGLE CORRECTION
Edit the first image, the existing black-and-lime basketball thumbnail. This is the single permitted correction pass.
Input roles: Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is Yusei Sano's official profile portrait, an identity reference only, not a photo to paste. Image 3 is the approved graphic style reference only.
Change ONLY the illustration on the right to improve safe framing and the same real player's likeness. Keep all existing typography, exact wording, colors, black/lime graphic style, text hierarchy and footer unchanged. Keep the canvas wide, approximately 16:9, with width at least 1000 px.
The entire crown of his head is currently clipped by the top edge. Scale the entire illustrated player and ball down about 12%, and position him so there is clearly visible dark background of about 5% image height ABOVE all of his hair. Keep BOTH hands and every fingertip entirely above the black footer, with a visible gap between fingers and the footer. The ball and controlling hand must both be fully inside the illustration region. The only acceptable intentional crop is the lower legs at the footer. Keep the same one-person low driving/dribbling action, anatomically coherent body and arms, natural five-finger hands.
Match the player to Image 2 more precisely: Yusei Sano / 佐野悠星. Give him SHORTER black hair, particularly reduce the tall top volume and shorten the fringe. It is swept back from a side/near-center part exposing the forehead, short sides. A slim oval face with slightly angular jaw, relatively slender straight eyes, straight eyebrows, straight nose, clean shaven, lean compact adult guard build. Retain hand-drawn ink hatching, not photorealism. No player name or jersey number in the image, no team or league logo, no sponsor.
Preserve every existing visible text verbatim:
バスケまとめ
11/21
試合予定
B.ONE・B.NEXT
試合前
当日TOP3・ベスト5は公式記録確定待ち
2026/11/21 02:42〜02:43 JST時点
